assessment: This paper will be of interest to neurophysiologists and systems neuroscientists interested in memory and more specifically in hippocampo-cortical interactions. Using a combination of imaging and electrophysiological techniques, the important study characterizes neocortical activity patterns around awake hippocampal ripples. The results provide solid evidence that cortical activity seems to be dominated by inhibition around awake ripples, unlike sleep ripples, but differences between intrinsic activity and synaptic transmission highlight complex interactions in the underlying neuronal circuits and dynamics.
